text: Chromatics [Gr. crwmatikoV , relating to colour]: Ger. (1) Farbenlehre , (2) chromatische Tonlehre ; Fr. chromatique ; Ital. cromatica . (1) The science of colour. The term should properly be limited to colour as a function of light, but it is often applied to colour-sensation effects. Cf. VISION. ( J.M.B. ) (2) Scales or series of notes including the black keys of the piano, or sharps and flats on the staff; they run in the scale of twelve semitones. Cf. Parry, art. Chromatic, in Grove's Dict . of Music and Musicians , i. 355 (1879). ( E.B.T. )
